title: log-stack — demo app logs
description: The demo app writes JSON log lines to stdout on a fixed interval (see values.yaml demoApp) — no /metrics, no Service, nothing Loki-specific about it. Promtail (a DaemonSet, one pod per node) tails every container's stdout on its node and ships it to Loki regardless; this dashboard is just Grafana querying that. Verified live: `| json` parsing depends on values.yaml's promtail.config.snippets.pipelineStages matching this cluster's container runtime (docker) — get that wrong and every panel here reads zero with no error anywhere.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Defaults to All. A hardcoded namespace here renders every panel empty on any install that used a different one.

panels.title: Error lines (1h)
panels.description: count_over_time on level="ERROR" — every 10th heartbeat line by design (see values.yaml), so a non-zero, non-climbing count here is expected and healthy, not a symptom of anything broken.

panels.title: Total lines (1h)
panels.description: Proves the pipeline is actually moving lines, independent of level — the number to check first if the panels above look suspiciously flat.

panels.title: Log rate by level
panels.description: sum by (level) of the parsed JSON's `level` field — the shape you'd actually alert on (a sudden ERROR spike), not just a raw line count.

panels.title: Live log stream
panels.description: Structured JSON on stdout — no log file, nothing to rotate, the container runtime plus Promtail handle shipping. Use the Level filter above; it rewrites the query rather than filtering client-side, so it stays fast on a large window.
